craft_notes: Sthāyin: relish swelling thousandfold. Device: em-dash→comma (trio stated softly), kept closing dash (swelling released). Rejected: 'tang' glossed as zeal — killed: tang IS the rasa-word here, kept; smoothing the three verbs — killed: worshipped/mused/gladdened is the rite, all three stay. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Honoured here, mused here, gladdened here — this very tang,
in thousand rills, Bhava, in me, of mine — O swell.
l4.sanskrit_cite: arcito 'yam ayaṃ dhyāta eṣa toṣita ity ayam rasaḥ srotaḥsahasreṇa tvayi me bhava vardhatām
